summary.heading: Professional Summary
summary.body: Product and people leader with 13+ years building and scaling enterprise SaaS products and product teams. Leads and develops product managers, sets strategy across complex portfolios, and combines customer discovery and commercial product strategy with deep experience in AI, mobile, data, and APIs. Partners closely with engineering on mission-critical platforms where availability, security, resiliency, and performance matter.
